'''Soara Antana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|So glad you could join us".<br />"Thought you might have missed us. Master, you're hurt!"<br />"Just a minor inconvenience..."|Darra Thel-Tanis and her Master Soara Antana in the midst of a rescue operation by Darra and her fellow Padawans, to free their battle-droid besieged Masters in the "ground canyons" of Radnor|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice">''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref>}}
A graceful [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Soara Antana was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. A noted [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] virtuoso—described even as "a legend"<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice" />—Antana was stationed at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where she served as a lightsaber instructor. At the request of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Antana (who had also recently just become a Knight) began training Kenobi's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], in specialized [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. Circa [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Antana took on [[Darra Thel-Tanis]] as her Padawan.<ref name="TWA" />

On their first [[Mission to Radnor|mission]] together, Antana and Thel-Tanis accompanied Jedi Master [[Ry-Gaul]] and his Padawan [[Tru Veld/Legends|Tru Veld]], Master [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] and her Padawan [[Ferus Olin]], as well as Kenobi and Skywalker to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]] to help with the evacuation of that world. The evacuation was due to a deadly toxin that had spread throughout the planet because of a weapons chemical leak. Antana and the other Jedi later discovered that the toxic leak was connected with the local [[Avoni]] raiders. The evidence ultimately led to [[Galen (Radnoran)|Galen]], a traitorous [[Radnoran]], who was taken into custody for his crimes. The Avoni, however, escaped prosecution. During the mission, Antana was injured by a [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]], but soon recovered.

Around [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], Antana and Thel-Tanis continued to undertake assignments together, including an escort mission to [[Nuralee]]. After [[Granta Omega]] and [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], both enemies of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], were tracked, Antana accompanied Kenobi, Skywalker, Olin, Ry-Gaul, and Veld on a [[Mission to Korriban (23 BBY)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the ancient birthplace of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. During the mission, the Jedi entered the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], where they sensed how strong the dark side was. They were ambushed by [[Korriban zombie]]s, which led to the death of Antana's Padawan at the hands of Granta Omega.

As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] started, Soara participated alongside Kenobi and Skywalker in several missions against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. As the wars ended in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Soara was killed during the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|assault]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]—the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="TWA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Curi, we don't have time for your hesitations," Soara prodded bluntly ... "You know what his means about the comm systems, don't you? ... The Avoni must be jamming the planet. It's the only explanation.|Jedi Master Soara Antana|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice" />}}
Soara Antana was a young athletic woman of sturdy, muscular build, with powerful hands. The speed of her combat rhythms was exceptional, described as being "faster" than even the quick and agile Jedi Masters Siri Tachi and Obi-Wan Kenobi; Anakin Skywalker was likewise "astonished" by her fighting abilities. While being prodigiously talented in lightsaber combat and admired by all, Soara was nevertheless described as having a very "blunt" personality—known for her "no-nonsense" approach to the task at hand.
